entities.summary: The Musée Français de la Carte à Jouer is a museum of playing cards in Paris, France. It is located at 16, rue Auguste Gervais, in the suburb of Issy-les-Moulineaux. Nearby is Mairie d'Issy station, the southern terminus of Paris Métro Line 12. The museum is open Wednesdays through Sundays, and an admission fee is charged.
